222-527-5147-8201.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-5147-8201.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1418-2226-4415.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1418-2226-4415.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Virtue of Knowledge.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Stonecloaker by paying its mana cost.
When Stonecloaker enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

5671-7084-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, The Necrobloom triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

147-2921-3905.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2921-3905.description:
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Unbreakable Bond.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Unbreakable Bond
Resolve the Unbreakable Bond copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

687-2034-7803-8130.easyPrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a creature you control.
687-2034-7803-8130.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
687-2034-7803-8130.description:
Activate Wall of Roots by putting two -0/-1 counters on it (due to Brad Boimler), adding {G}.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control.
In response to Tayam's ability, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wall of Roots, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling yourself three cards and returning Wall of Roots from your graveyard to the battlefield with two vigilance counters on it due to Tayam and Brad Boimler.
Repeat.
687-2034-7803-8130.notes: This order of operations and the {2} starting mana are necessary because you cannot pay the counter removal cost before sacrificing the creature to Ashnod's Altar, due to the timing sequence of the activated ability rules.

2281-3305-3899.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Body Launderer.
When Saffi dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing it to connive.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1003-3899-4053-6989.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

1170-2146-2981-5131--202.easyPrerequisites:
Cloud Key has "Artifact" chosen.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2146-2981-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Cloud Key.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn
Repeat.

1879-2034-6723-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

1270-2457-4289-7730.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three creature tokens.
Activate two creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

225-774-1362.description:
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant's ability by tapping it, untapping any land you control.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

5147-6255-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
5147-6255-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Zahur and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Zahur trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1492-7297.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-7297.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Welding Jar from your graveyard.
Cast Welding Jar by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1734-4681-6797.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

539-851-3899-4552-7170.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Living Brain.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1876-3129-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
1876-3129-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Nissa, Worldwaker
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

2203-2366-3499-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2203-2366-3499-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Vorinclex triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

539-3062-3899-4552-4694.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat

5078-6766-7052.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

4772-5900-7009.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus an additional {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
4772-5900-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Doubling Season.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

1074-3525-4289.description:
Activate King Macar by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, allowing you to exile a creature and create a Gold token if you do so.
Repeat.

1561-6272.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have max speed.
1561-6272.description:
Cast Peer into the Abyss by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}, causing you to draw half your library and lose half your life total, rounding up each time.
Aether Syphon triggers, causing each opponent to mill 2 cards for each card drawn this way.

1309-1987-4125-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1309-1987-4125-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Salvager of Secrets and Shipwreck Dowser.
When Salvager of Secrets and Shipwreck Dowser enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1309-1987-4125-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

225-1479-4288-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You are able to play a land this turn.
225-1479-4288-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Sarinth Greatwurm and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2054-2059-2440-4183.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Village Bell-Ringer
2054-2059-2440-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Village Bell-Ringer with haste.
When the token Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Village Bell-Ringer trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Village Bell-Ringer, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Village Bell-Ringer for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Urn of Godfire twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

277-1170-2733-5334-5954.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1462-6054.description:
Cast Gremlin Tamer by paying its mana cost.
When Gremlin Tamer enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, it triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, Gremlin Tamer's second ability triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat step 3.

648-3384-5757.notablePrerequisites:
Sokrates does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to give a creature haste.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
648-3384-5757.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your eck size.
Give the Fractal token haste, if needed.
Activate Sokrates by tapping it, targeting the Fractal token.
Declare the Fractal token as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block it.
When the Fractal token would deal combat damage, instead prevent that damage. The defending player draws cards equal to the Fractal's power, rounded down, while you will draw double that many cards due to Thought Reflection.

1755-2068-5473.description:
Activate Door to Nothingness by paying {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, tapping and sacrificing it, targeting an opponent.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers twice.
Resolve the first Ashnod the Uncaring trigger, copying the Door to Nothingness ability, targeting an opponent.
Resolve the Door to Nothingness ability created in step 3, causing the targeted opponent to lose the game.
Resolve the second Ashnod the Uncaring trigger, copying the Door to Nothingness ability, targeting an opponent.
Resolve the Door to Nothingness ability created in step 5, causing the targeted opponent to lose the game.
Resolve the Door to Nothingness ability in step 1, causing the targeted opponent to lose the game.

509-1267-4639-5546.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Jhoira's Timebug does not have summoning sickness.
509-1267-4639-5546.description:
Activate Unctus by paying {U/P}, causing Medomai the Ageless to become an artifact until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Activate Jhoira's Timebug by tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 6.

1462-2232-2413-2768-5070.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 8.
You have not cast a spell using Demon of Fate's Design's ability this turn.
1462-2232-2413-2768-5070.description:
Cast Day of the Dragons by paying 7 life due to Demon of Fate's Design.
When Day of the Dragons enters the battlefield, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Day of the Dragons trigger, exiling all creatures you control and creating that many 5/5 Dragon creature tokens.
When the Dragon(s) enter the battlefield, Angelic Chorus and Cloudstone Curio trigger that many times.
Resolve all Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 5 life for each Dragon that entered the battlefield.
Resolve all but one Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the final Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Day of the Dragons to your hand from the battlefield.
When Day of the Dragons leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice all Dragons you control and return all cards exiled with Day of the Dragons to the battlefield.
 When Demon of Fate's Design and any other creature(s) that were exiled by Day of the Dragons enter the battlefield, Angelic Chorus and Cloudstone Curio trigger that many times.
Resolve all Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life equal to the collective toughness of the creatures that entered the battlefield.
Resolve all Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

190-389-1984-5248.description:
Cast Angel's Grace by paying {W}.
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, however you cannot lose the game due to Angel's Grace.
Cast Cleansing Nova by paying its mana cost, destroying all enchantments.
When each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, they each trigger, causing each opponent to lose the game.

147-695.easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Settle Beyond Reality.
147-695.description:
Cast Settle Beyond Reality by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Settle Beyond Reality, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Settle Beyond Reality, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

2103-3742-4125.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
2103-3742-4125.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou, taking an extra turn after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser that is tapped and attacking.
Shipwreck Dowser enters, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

643-1486-4091.notablePrerequisites: Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
643-1486-4091.description:
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting itself.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

1263-2034-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {C}{C}.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

1966-2452-2577.description:
Activate Nim Shambler's ability by sacrificing Gravecrawler, regenerate Nim Shambler.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3263-4246-4286.description: Players cannot generate mana from activated abilities, making it nearly impossible to pay Archangel of Tithe's additional cost.

413-2060-2265-3062-5105.manaNeeded: {4} in at least three different colors
413-2060-2265-3062-5105.description:
Cast Crystalline Crawler giving it 5 +1/+1 counters because of Pir, Imaginative Rascal and harden scales.
Remove all five counters getting {W} {U} {B} {R} {G}.
Sacrifice Crawler to Blasting Station tapping it to deal 1 damage.
Pay Sigil's cost of {1}{W} returning Crawler to hand.
Recast Crystalline Crawler for all of the remaining floating mana giving it six +1/+1 counters and untapping Blasting Station.
Remove all six counters netting {6} of assorted colors containing {W} {W} {U} {B} {R} {G}.
Repeat steps 4-7 adding mana along the way.
